records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the fiscal year ended March 31, 2023, 45% of our consumption-based revenues were derived from fees paid for data ingest and 55% were derived from fees paid for provisioned users.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The remaining increase was driven by a $2.4 million increase in software subscription and consulting expenses and a $1.3 million increase in travel expenses.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We had remaining performance obligations of $808.1 million and $706.1 million as of March 31, 2023 and March 31, 2022, respectively, consisting of both billed and unbilled consideration.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our gross margin for the fiscal years ended March 31, 2023 and 2022 was 73% and 67%, respectively, primarily driven by the transition of our platform from local data centers to public cloud hosting providers.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During the fiscal year ended March 31, 2023, cash provided by operating activities was $53.8 million, which was an increase of $50.1 million, or 1,384%, from cash provided by operating activities of $3.6 million during the fiscal year ended March 31, 2022.
